title: Agents as Pentesters
youtube_title: Agents as Pentesters: Continuous, Automated Security Testing | The Agentic Crew, Appendix A
description: Authorised, autonomous penetration testing as a case study in agentic engineering. It covers a multi-phase pipeline, a sentinel that routes work by what changed, absolute guardrails, an exploitation feedback loop, finding deduplication, tiered models, and a dashboard that keeps a human in the loop.
